Happy 25th Birthday, My Isaiah ♡

My honey love,

I don't even know where to start because there are so many things I want to tell you. You are one of the most special people I've ever known, and I'm so grateful that you came into my life. You've made the last five years incredible, and I feel so lucky to get to call you mine.

From our first date on that cliff at night, when everything just felt magical, to all the little moments in between, you've always made me feel safe, loved, and understood. You make even the ordinary days feel special, and I appreciate everything you do for me more than you might realize. You always show up for me, support me, take care of me, and love me in the most thoughtful ways.

The first time you told me you knew you loved me was when you first tickled me, and honestly, it still makes me smile because it's such a you thing. You find joy in the little things, and you make me laugh harder than anyone else. I'm so grateful for your patience, your kindness, your strength, and the way you always try to make my life easier and happier.

I love how we can just cuddle for hours, watching our favorite movies, whether it's sci-fi, horror, or psychological thrillers. Those nights are some of my favorite, just being with you, talking about everything and nothing at the same time. You make me feel at home, and there's no one else I would rather spend my time with.

I'm so proud of you, honey love. You work hard, you always try your best, and you inspire me every day. You care about the people you love, and you're always thinking about how to make me feel happy and loved. I notice everything you do, even the small things, and I'm so grateful for you.

Thank you for being my best friend, my partner in adventures, my safe place, and my favorite person. Thank you for being you. I'm excited for everything we still get to experience together, and I can't wait to keep making memories with you.

Five years ago, we sat together on a cliff beneath the night sky. I didn't know every adventure we'd have ahead of us, but I'd choose to keep discovering them with you.

Happy 25th birthday, boob. I love you so much. If I could choose again, in every lifetime, I'd still choose you.

Forever yours, ♡
